name: Poisson on cube, PCG vs DirectSolver
slurm_script_str:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: poisson_direct_vs_pcg (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Repeated Poisson solves comparing cached DirectSolver against PCG."
echo "Physics problem: Poisson field solve with manufactured solution on a 3D cuboid."
echo "Struphy model used: Poisson"
echo "Case directory: /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175024Z-0d17dfcc/poisson_direct_vs_pcg"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175024Z-0d17dfcc/poisson_direct_vs_pcg/sim_04"
cp "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/direct_vs_pcg/params_poisson_solver.py" "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175024Z-0d17dfcc/poisson_direct_vs_pcg/parameters.py"

echo "Running poisson_direct_vs_pcg with 1 MPI ranks"
cd "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175024Z-0d17dfcc/poisson_direct_vs_pcg"
mpirun -n 1 /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/python /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/direct_vs_pcg/params_poisson_solver.py --id 4 --solver direct --num-elements 16 8 8 --repeats 100 > "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175024Z-0d17dfcc/poisson_direct_vs_pcg/sim_04/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: poisson_direct_vs_pcg (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
